question: Do the weight-enriched block9 H1/H4 heads causally write the cue-conditioned subject state that block11H3 reads, explaining part of the second cross-task H3 mode?

authority.known_fact: Exact weights rank L9H1 first and L9H4 third among all 110 upstream head/MLP writers into the rank-two H3 read map; earlier causal work established L8H1 as the cue-to-subject writer and L9H1/H4 plus L11H3 as material readers, but did not test the serial subject-destination L9-to-H3 edge.

frozen_design.population: All A1/A2 Next-year/Last-year rows from the passed capability authority.
frozen_design.writer: Install the exact L8H1 cue-source response at the two subject-onset destinations.
frozen_design.capture: Capture writer-induced block9 head-output deltas at the subject destinations and block11H3's final-query output response.
frozen_design.arms: Install into an otherwise native base run each of nine block9 singleton head responses, H1+H4, their seven-head complement, and all nine heads, always only at subject destinations. Capture H3 on the same forward.
frozen_design.outcomes: Behavioral donor recovery and rowwise norm of the H3 response projected into the frozen rank-two task-union basis. No fit or greedy selection occurs; H1/H4 are frozen by weights.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_capture_clos: Authorities hold, v4 capability remains passed, all attention reconstructions <=5e-4, row coverage and exact price hold, and values are finite.
predictions.pred_b_writer_and_full_l9_subject_respon: The L8H1 writer is donorward on every row and all-nine L9 subject responses preserve at least 3% of its mean behavioral effect in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_weight_selected_pair_dominates_h3: H1+H4 preserve at least 60% of the all-nine mean projected H3 response norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_unselected_complement_is_secondar: The seven-head complement preserves at most 40% of the all-nine mean projected H3 response norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_both_weight_selected_heads_rank_n: H1 and H4 each rank among the top four singleton heads by projected H3 response norm in both panels.

decision: screen if all predictions pass; distributed if A,B pass but C,D,or E fails; null if A holds but the complete L9 subject response is immaterial; invalid if A fails. This tests an exact serial edge, not generic weight correlation.
